propositions: Five analysis and calibration artifacts cited in merged tickets (cranial-goodly-seahog and restoring-shallow-blobfish) exist only as untracked working-tree state and are not committed to origin/main, leaving dangling citations in criteria_routing.json and breaking provenance trails.

The criteria_routing.json file contains three _comment fields that cite docs/experiments/calibrate_code_review_thresholds.py, which does not exist on main, making justification for the four blocking criterion flips uninspectable.

The escaped-bug correlation analysis and write-parity oracle prototype are referenced as the empirical basis for design decisions but the source artifacts are not in the repository, preventing audit of the supporting evidence.

Five analysis artifacts (calibrate_code_review_thresholds.py, code-review-threshold-calibration.md, escaped_bug_analysis.py, escaped-bug-review-gap-analysis.md, write_parity_oracle_prototype.py) must be committed verbatim to docs/experiments/ to resolve citations and restore provenance chain.
The landing is docs-only, static analysis content outside lint sources and packaged wheel, inert at runtime with no CI execution required.
